data.desc: Sunshine Biopharma currently has 61 generic prescription drugs on the market in Canada andapproximately 11 additional drugs expected to be launched in the remainder of 2026. In addition, Sunshine Biopharma is conducting a proprietary drug development program which is comprised of (i) K1.1 mRNA, an mRNA-Lipid Nanoparticle targeted for liver cancer, and (ii) PLpro protease inhibitor, a small-molecule for treatment of SARS Coronavirus infections.
